decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant-management line and was launched publicly only recently, so management will attribute any slow uptake to ramp-up and keep it.
The cleaning centrifuge supports the announced direction toward efficient, sustainable coolant handling and carries real development investment, so management will keep it.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost complement to the coolant systems and are already shown on the website, so there is little reason to withdraw them.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits at the heart of the established conveying business, so it remains central to the firm's identity and range.
The magnetic belt conveyor builds on core chip-conveying competence and belongs to a modular range the firm has committed to in public.
The hinged belt conveyor is a standard part of the firm's core portfolio for metalworking customers, so dropping it would contradict the strategy the firm has announced.
